component.name: Comic Scroll Reader
component.summary: Continuous scroll and single-page reader for comics, image folders, and PDFs

description.p: Comic Scroll Reader is a fast, purpose-built desktop reader designed specifically for comics, manga, webtoons, and image collections.

ul.li: Continuous vertical scroll mode with seamless page stitching and boundary traversal
Single-page view with fit-to-width, fit-to-height, and smooth anchored zoom
High-performance asynchronous image pipeline for instant decoding and low memory footprint
Fast, on-demand PDF document rendering powered by Google PDFium
Comprehensive keyboard and mouse shortcuts, fullscreen mode, and auto-hiding HUD
Folder and archive browsing with natural numerical sorting

description.p: Initial stable 1.0 release of Comic Scroll Reader with full PDF and image folder reading support.
